scope: Review of combined reference view sets, separate from dimensions/topology/whole-map acceptance. Each individual image retains its stated limits.

sets.review: Combined ground views show both portal faces and intervening chamber; side frame reads chamber support/wall and elevation frame reads floor and portal arrangement. Cropped side portal is supplied by ground forward/reverse frames.
sets.remaining: Structural opening endpoint/height, chamber length, leaf-clearance measurements remain Gate1 blockers.

sets.review: Both standing-eye portal faces are clear; side approach supplies wall/slope/steps, elevation frame supplies portal threshold and full gap. Distant threshold occlusion in side view is supplied by elevation frame.
sets.remaining: Full structural opening and minimum leaf clearance are unresolved; B Window and B courtyard are separate areas.

sets.review: Complete flight/side parapet is unobstructed in forward/side views. Reverse shows lower landing; nearest treads clipped there are supplied by forward/side. High perspective shows both approach platforms and walls.
sets.remaining: This certifies the stair reference set only. Catwalk/Mid approach coverage and stair run/count interpretation are separate unresolved tasks.

sets.review: Both-direction floor/wall corridor, corner turn and elevation above Mid are clear in combined views. Pole/wires are existing source geometry; wider plan replaces clipped roof-dominated attempt.
sets.remaining: Full A Short upper branch still needs dedicated references. Local width samples do not certify entire platform/cover bounds.
